description: A word-sized trend in plain SVG and CSS, no charting library: a line, an area or a row of bars from a list of numbers, with its last point marked. It draws itself on arrival, tweens into new data (a week into a month and back), colours itself by its news if you ask, and lets people scrub it with the pointer or the arrow keys while its value rolls in a small readout. Its trend and change are readable by screen readers and agents.
moves: A line draws itself from the left with its area unrolling under it; the last point pops in once the line reaches it.
Bars grow from the baseline one after another, left to right, in about half a second whatever their number.
New data tweens the line, the area, every bar, the reference line and the last point to their new places. Up to 97 points, any length tweens into any other.
While someone scrubs, a hairline and a dot ride to the point under the pointer and the readout follows them, swinging inward near the edges.
The readout's value rolls to each new number.
keyboard: Moves focus to the sparkline's points as one tab stop and shows the point's value.
Moves to the next point and shows its value.
Hides the readout; any arrow brings it back.

propDocs.Sparkline.labels: A name for each point, like "Nov 12", shown in the readout and read out for each point.
propDocs.Sparkline.curve: "smooth" (the default, never overshooting a point) or "linear".
propDocs.Sparkline.label: What it measures, like "Revenue". Starts the accessible summary and the name agents see.
propDocs.Sparkline.period: The span it covers, like "last 14 days". The summary reads "Revenue, last 14 days, up 12%".
propDocs.Sparkline.formatValue: Formats a value for the readout and the point names: `(value) => string`.
propDocs.Sparkline.trendColor: Draws in the colour of its news: green when the trend is good, the destructive colour when bad, muted when flat.
propDocs.Sparkline.downIsGood: A fall is good news (refunds, churn, response time): the tone, and so the trend colour, turns round.
propDocs.Sparkline.flatThreshold: A change from the first point to the last smaller than this share counts as flat. Defaults to 0.01.
propDocs.Sparkline.reference: A value to draw a dashed line at: a target, a budget, last period's average. `null` for none.
propDocs.Sparkline.extremes: Marks the highest and the lowest point with a hollow dot.
propDocs.Sparkline.includeZero: Keeps zero in the value range. Defaults to true for bars and false for lines and areas.
propDocs.Sparkline.activeIndex: The point being read (hovered or focused), controlled. `null` for none.
propDocs.Sparkline.defaultActiveIndex: The point shown at first, when you don't control it.
propDocs.Sparkline.onActiveIndexChange: Runs when the point being read changes, with details.reason "item-hover", "item-press", "list-navigation", "focus-in", "focus-out", "escape-key" or "pointer-leave".
propDocs.Sparkline.speed: How fast it moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.

cssVars: The ring round the dots (the surface it sits on)
